Keeper remembers.\"", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市陷入最深沉的寂静。路灯将空旷的街道染成昏黄，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过积水的声响被夜色吞没。清洁工推着手推车缓缓前行，扫帚与沥青摩擦出单调的节奏。远处工地的塔吊亮着红色警示灯，像一只不眠的眼睛注视着沉睡的楼群。二十四小时便利店的灯光洒在人行道上，店员靠着柜台打盹，咖啡机发出低沉的嗡鸣。一只流浪猫从巷口窜出，踩过湿漉漉的落叶，消失在黎明到来之前最黑暗的那一刻。整座城市像一个屏住呼吸的人，等待第一缕晨光将它唤醒。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem, like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case\" — a simple version of the problem it can answer right away without calling itself again, so it doesn't keep going forever.\n• Imagine you're in a line of people and you want to know how many are behind you: you ask the person behind you how many are behind them, they ask the next person, and so on until the last person says \"zero\" — then each answer passes back up the line."}
